text:
devon: Quick heads-up — after the smoke deploy to staging a few minutes ago I spotted an email fragment in one of the debug logs. Probably low volume but want to scope before we escalate.

maria: can you paste the snippet? if it's full email we need redact + audit access. :eyes:

devon: pasted below. removed other context but you can see the pattern. not a token, just user email and a short prompt.

```
[2026-11-12T16:02:11Z] request_id=ae3f user_id=12345 prompt="Summarize invoice for alice@example.com" response_time=12ms
```

adele: looks like a prompt that includes an email address. staging only? any chance prod saw this pattern?

devon: only in staging canary for now. the canary used a debug-level flag that logs the raw prompt. turns out our default log config didn't mask prompts for test tenants.

ops_jordan: tagging infra — can we flip the debug flag off and run a quick redact job on the last 2 hours of staging logs? also need to rotate any keys if we logged tokens (not the case here but double-check).

sre-bot: Deploy job 5762 rolled back debug-logging flag at 16:04. No active canaries remain.

maria: good. steps: 1) confirm scope (staging only), 2) redact stored logs, 3) confirm no backups/exports have copies, 4) comms (internal only unless prod affected).

adele: I'll run a grep+sed redact on the staging bucket. plan to replace email-like strings with `<redacted-email>` and keep a short audit file listing keys of modified objects.

maria: make sure the redact job preserves object versioning and add an audit log entry with who ran it and why. tag it `privacy:staging-email-redact`.

ops_jordan: running the redact job now against `staging-logs/*/2026-11-12/*`. ETA ~6m.

sre-bot: Redact job started by ops_jordan at 16:07. Objects matched: 12. Progress: 3/12.

devon: thanks. one policy question — do we need to CC legal or privacy for a staging-only exposure of a single non-sensitive email? (asking to follow process)

legal_aly: ping — FYI staging exposures fall under our incident playbook if they contain PII. For a single email in staging with no PHI/SSN and no prod exposure, we still document and file a low-severity privacy incident. No external notice required. Please include the audit manifest.

adele: redact job complete. replaced 12 objects. created audit manifest: `s3://audit/staging-email-redact/manifest-1967890123.csv` (contains object keys, original timestamps, operator).

maria: can you paste the manifest header and one example line (no original content)? we need to attach to the incident ticket.

adele: header: `object_key,version_id,modified_by,modified_at,reason`

example: `staging-logs/service-x/2026-11-12/0003.log,3ff2a,adele,2026-11-12T16:09:23Z,redacted email in prompt`

devon: confirmed no prod runs with debug flag. I scanned canary metadata and only canary-id=5762 had the flag. will file the incident and link the manifest.

maria: OK file a Privacy-LOW ticket, tag `privacy`, `staging`, and `ops`. add timeline + manifest link. also note mitigation: rollback debug flag, redaction complete, no prod impact.

ops_jordan: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-4321 — added manifest and timeline.

legal_aly: adding label `no-notice` for internal tracking. good work — please keep a copy of the redact audit in the secure audit bucket for 7 years per retention policy.

devon: noted. one follow-up: can we update the deploy template to avoid enabling raw-prompt debug logging by default? I'll open a PR after lunch.

maria: do that and ping infra for a quick review. also add a unit test that lint rejects `LOG_PROMPT_RAW=true` in prod templates.

adele: will backfill a short runbook entry under `docs/privacy/runbooks/staging-log-redaction.md` after the ticket is closed.

devon: thanks everyone — closing here once PRIV-4321 is triaged and legal confirms the labels. :white_check_mark:
